movie.title: The Man Who Wasn't There
movie.overview: A tale of murder, crime and punishment set in the summer of 1949. Ed Crane, a barber in a small California town, is dissatisfied with his life, but his wife Doris' infidelity and a mysterious opportunity presents him with a chance to change it.

facts: Did you know the film is precisely set in the summer of 1949? It really nails that specific post-war atmosphere!
Our main character, Ed Crane, has a rather unassuming job for a noir protagonist – he's a barber in a small California town.
A key turning point in the story is Ed's wife, Doris', infidelity, which sets him on a mysterious new path.
